No container image is exported, pushed, published, or redistributed.

decision.rationale: Every non-security release surface remains exact, but the renewed scan finds two unique HIGH vulnerabilities in the frozen base packages. The frozen zero-critical/high gate fails, so v0.0.31 must remain untagged and unreleased.
